_doc: OT AES. No interrupts (the block has no INTR_STATE); two alerts via the standard alert_tx auto-detection. Translated with -G AESGCMEnable=0 (Earl Grey instantiates GCM disabled — hw/top_earlgrey/data/top_earlgrey.hjson), -G SecMasking=0 and -G SecSBoxImpl=SBoxImplLut (functional simplification: masking is a side-channel countermeasure with bit-identical ciphertext; the masked DOM S-box and PRNG are microarchitecture the MMIO model cannot observe).
